{'translation': 'Starting November 5, Apple Arcade subscribers will be able to play "Crossy Road Rush," a brand-new arcade island adventure game featuring both a single-player mode and a four-player multiplayer racing mode. You can check out the trailer for the new game below.', 'msg': '[0] 11月5日起，Apple Arcade訂閱用戶將可以玩到《Crossy Road Rush》，呢款全新街機島嶼冒險遊戲設有單人模式同四人多人對戰賽車模式。喺下面可以睇到新遊戲嘅預告片。'}

{'translation': '"Crossy Road Rush" launches on November 5', 'msg': '[1] 《Crossy Road Rush》將於11月5日登場'}

{'translation': 'Apple Arcade and Hipster Whale jointly announced today that the all-new "Crossy Road Rush" will be available exclusively on Apple\'s game subscription platform starting November 5.', 'msg': '[2] Apple Arcade同Hipster Whale今日聯合宣布，確認呢款全新《Crossy Road Rush》將會由11月5日起獨家登陸Apple嘅遊戲訂閱平台。'}

{'translation': 'The game retains the signature style of "Crossy Road" and "Crossy Road Castle," continuing with colorful pixel-art characters and environments, but adds more adventure-focused elements, including combat, exploration, and multiplayer modes.', 'msg': '[3] 遊戲沿用咗《Crossy Road》同《Crossy Road Castle》一貫嘅風格，繼續有色彩繽紛嘅像素風角色同環境，但就加入咗更多以冒險為核心嘅元素，包括戰鬥、探索同多人模式。'}

{'translation': "Below is a description of the Apple Arcade exclusive from Crossy Road's YouTube channel:", 'msg': '[4] 以下係Crossy Road嘅YouTube頻道對呢款Apple Arcade獨家遊戲嘅介紹：'}

{'translation': 'The game will officially launch at 8:00 AM Hong Kong time on November 6 (4:00 PM Pacific Standard Time on November 5), but Apple Arcade subscribers can pre-order here now.', 'msg': '[5] 遊戲將會喺香港時間11月6日上午8時（太平洋標準時間11月5日下午4時）正式推出，不過Apple Arcade訂閱用戶而家已經可以喺呢度預購。'}

{'translation': "This announcement comes just days after Apple Arcade added five new games earlier this month: Pusheen's Place, River City Survivors, Terraria+, Touchgrind BMX 2+, and 4 Pics 1 Word+.", 'msg': "[6] 今次嘅公布距離Apple Arcade今個月初新增五款遊戲只係相隔幾日，嗰五款遊戲分別係Pusheen's Place、River City Survivors、Terraria+、Touchgrind BMX 2+同4 Pics 1 Word+。"}

{'translation': 'You can watch the trailer for "Crossy Road Rush" below:', 'msg': '[7] 喺下面可以睇到《Crossy Road Rush》嘅預告片：'}

{'translation': 'Apple Arcade is available as a standalone subscription for $6.99 per month, or through an Apple One bundle. The service includes over 200 games, with no ads and no in-app purchases.', 'msg': '[8] Apple Arcade可以作為獨立服務訂閱，月費為6.99美元，亦可以透過Apple One組合方案訂閱。服務包含超過200款遊戲，冇廣告亦冇程式內購。'}
